assertions: Original static/dynamic defaults and metadata retain actual identity under JS GC.
Actual single-pool package registration and slot lookup reuse the existing shared pool and exact source cache condition.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task141 ports actual ItemInfo three-field/copy metadata, Static/Dynamic default entries and ItemInfoPackage with original protected replacement, shared EMPTY and nonzero SlotID cache. Existing SfxItemPool gains the actual package registration/default lookup/first-last range and single-pool slot conversion paths, preserving supplied default identity and constructing only required dynamic entries through real callbacks. Original debug/invalid preconditions receive host errors without fabricated default values. Existing flat browser default/factory API remains distinct and unchanged when no native package is registered; no complete native pool, chains or user-default claim. Native static/dynamic default tags are plain boolean classification, not memory management. Original protected/default/private setters retain their API visibility: two narrow erased native-friend casts and one exact typed constant-member friend access replace C++ friendship, without a runtime adapter or public setter. Native inline header values are co-located in the existing shared source owner and canonically reexported once. All object references/Maps use JS GC; no refcount, delete/dispose/weak lifetime engine or native probes. Real Calc183/184 set-item package witnesses use exact source ranges and independent requesting pools; zero test fixture slots do not claim the unported Calc SID catalog. Complete Calc DocPool/document/UI/ODS remain pending. Existing metadata history/classification/status and deliberate I/O/recovery differences retained without broad parity promotion.
